{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the graduate programs within the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at Arizona State University. I hope you will take a closer look at the exciting things going on in our department by visiting our prospective student page to learn more about the department and Our graduate programs.
The department offers PhD degrees in both chemistry and biochemistry, and all admitted students are fully funded, including the cost of tuition, health insurance and a competitive stipend.
Applications are currently being accepted for study beginning fall 2015. The application deadline is Jan. 15, 2015. We will not be admitting students for spring 2015.
Applying is a two-part process consisting of a general graduate application through the office of graduate admissions and a supplemental application to the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry. More detailed information about the application process is available on our prospective student – how to apply page as well as in our FAQ page.
We are a growing program and are conducting cutting edge, interdisciplinary research to solve societal problems at the molecular level, and I encourage you to check out the research being conducted by our faculty. I hope you will consider joining us.
If you have questions about the application process or graduate programs that are not included on our website, please email me and I will be happy to assist you.
Good luck in your pursuit of graduate studies.
David Nutt
Graduate Programs Coordinator
Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry
